summary: Auto-generated format support matrix from the live adapter registry, grouped by canonical content kind, in the kind hub's order and names, with adapter id, output extensions, and human label. It documents CLI listing, inspection, conversion, and validation, with SillyTavern CCv3 as a portable format for targets that accept Character Card v3. The current registry has eleven character, nine lorebook, four persona, one pack, four preset, one Script Sheet, five regex-set, one quick-reply and one prompt-format adapter. The pack adapter, image-pack, writes a zip of pictures and sounds. Tools (kind tool), dice (kind dice), formulas (kind formula), trackers (kind tracker), skills (kind skill) and drawings (kind htmldoc) have no import or export format yet, and their sections say so. Notes explain content-sniff detection, fixture-proven same-format round trips, honest cross-format loss reporting, and sample locations. Because the page is generated, counts and rows change only with the registry. Native Bunzai Promptbook and Agent adapters now read and write canonical JSON; these preserve reference IDs rather than embedding linked pieces.

sections.title: How to use
sections.summary: Documents the primary CLI entry points for format work: bun run bunzai formats to list adapters, bunzai inspect on a card path, bunzai convert with --to for a target such as sillytavern, and bunzai validate on card JSON. For targets accepting Character Card v3, the portable character format is SillyTavern CCv3 through the sillytavern adapter.

sections.title: Characters (11)
sections.summary: Eleven character adapters share the canonical character kind. Agnai, Backyard, RoleCall and Bunzai native write JSON. BYAF writes Backyard archives; Risu writes charx. Lumiverse writes JSON and charx. Pygmalion and SillyTavern write JSON or PNG. JanitorAI and Saucepan are export-only PNG targets using recorded importer mappings. Detection remains owned by each adapter, so export-only targets do not claim imported files.

sections.title: Lorebooks (9)
sections.summary: Nine lorebook adapters. JanitorAI and Saucepan add export-only ST world info JSON targets. agnai-lorebook writes .json Agnai memory books. marinara-lorebook writes .json native .marinara.json export. novelai-lorebook writes .lorebook for NovelAI native export or json. risu-lorebook writes .json RisuAI native export. rolecall-lorebook writes .json RoleCall v1 export. rolecall-compendium writes .json RoleCall compendium export. sillytavern-lorebook writes .json SillyTavern world info worldbook. All are kind lorebook.

sections.title: Personas (4)
sections.summary: Four persona adapters, all writing .json. lumiverse-persona is a Lumiverse account object. marinara-persona carries theming and stat bars sealed. rolecall-persona is rcpersona or RC persona-card export. sillytavern-persona is a SillyTavern personas backup where the default persona is primary and the rest ride sealed.

sections.title: Notes
sections.summary: Detection is content-sniff, not only extension; prefer bunzai label when unsure. Same-format round-trips aim for lossless where fixtures prove it, see adapter tests and samples/. Cross-format convert keeps what the target can express; use export honesty in the studio UI for drop notes. Target-specific fields may be omitted during cross-format conversion; review the export report.
